summary: community.hashi_vault dropped end-of-life ansible-core versions (tested with >= 2.17) and older Python versions.
questions: Which ansible-core versions does community.hashi_vault support?
Does community.hashi_vault still support old Python versions?

answer_card.title: community.hashi_vault version support
answer_card.answer_md: community.hashi_vault dropped support for all end-of-life ansible-core versions and is tested with **ansible-core >= 2.17**. Older Python versions were also dropped; it is tested on all supported controller Python versions and some lower target versions.
